content: The updates to Recommendation 12.15 and 12.16 emphasize the need for incorporating additional considerations for patients experiencing vision loss. These updates also highlight the importance of utilizing FDA-approved devices for the treatment of neuropathy and stress the critical role of rehabilitation and comprehensive evaluation in patient care. Recommendation 12.22 has been revised to prioritize the implementation of proper screening protocols for peripheral artery disease. Furthermore, it underscores the necessity of involving qualified podiatric specialists in the development and execution of treatment plans for affected patients.
